title: Venezuelan-Style Baked Scamorza
description: A twist on traditional Italian scamorza, this Venezuelan-inspired dish adds a sweet and spicy kick. The crispy exterior and creamy interior make for a delightful appetizer or snack.
instructions: Slice the scamorza into thick rounds.
Place the scamorza slices on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle with a little bit of oil and bake for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, toast the venezuelan chili pepper in a pan until fragrant.
Remove the scamorza from the oven and top each slice with a toasted venezuelan chili pepper.
Return to the oven for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the cheese is melted and slightly charred.
Serve the scamorza hot with a side of jammy for dipping.
